sender.ms: Nombor tidak dikenali yang mengaku “rider” atau syarikat kurier, kadangkala tahu nama dan alamat anda
sender.en: An unknown number claiming to be a “rider” or courier company, sometimes knowing your name and address

name.ms: “Bungkusan COD belum bayar”: kod QR di WhatsApp untuk bungkusan yang tidak wujud
name.en: “Unpaid COD parcel”: a QR code on WhatsApp for a parcel that doesn't exist

how.ms: Seseorang yang mengaku penghantar atau syarikat kurier menghantar WhatsApp bahawa ada bungkusan bayar semasa terima (COD) atau caj penghantaran tambahan atas nama anda, kadangkala dengan nama penuh dan alamat anda. Mesej itu disertakan kod QR dan desakan supaya membayar segera kerana “rider masih ada penghantaran lain”. Bayaran masuk ke akaun penipu, dan bungkusan itu tidak wujud. Postal Forum juga memberi amaran tentang manipulasi bayaran COD.
how.en: Someone claiming to be a delivery rider or courier company sends a WhatsApp message saying there is a cash-on-delivery (COD) parcel or an extra delivery charge in your name, sometimes with your full name and address. It comes with a QR code and pressure to pay at once because “the rider still has other deliveries”. The payment goes to the scammer's account, and the parcel does not exist. Postal Forum has also warned about COD payment manipulation.

text.ms: WhatsApp daripada “rider” tentang bungkusan COD atau caj tambahan atas nama anda.
text.en: A WhatsApp message from a “rider” about a COD parcel or an extra charge in your name.

text.ms: Mesej disertakan kod QR untuk dibayar segera.
text.en: It comes with a QR code to pay immediately.

text.ms: “Rider” mendesak kerana masih ada penghantaran lain.
text.en: The “rider” pushes you because there are other deliveries.

text.ms: Salam cik, saya rider. Ada 2 parcel COD atas nama cik, jumlah RM60. Boleh scan QR ni untuk bayar sekarang ya, saya ada banyak lagi barang nak hantar. Lepas bayar saya terus letak depan rumah.
text.en: Hi miss, I'm the rider. There are 2 COD parcels in your name, RM60 in total. Please scan this QR to pay now, I have lots more to deliver. Once you pay I'll leave them in front of your house.

ms: Bayaran COD yang diminta melalui kod QR di WhatsApp sebelum anda melihat bungkusan.
Bungkusan yang anda tidak pesan, atau caj tambahan untuk pesanan yang sudah dibayar.
en: A COD payment asked for by QR code on WhatsApp before you have seen the parcel.
A parcel you never ordered, or an extra charge for an order you already paid for.

ms: Semak pesanan anda dalam aplikasi platform tempat anda membeli.
Jangan bayar bungkusan yang anda tidak pesan; bayar COD hanya selepas menerima bungkusan.
Sekat nombor itu. Jika sudah membayar, hubungi bank anda dan 997.
en: Check your orders in the app of the platform you bought from.
Don't pay for parcels you didn't order; pay COD only once you have the parcel.
Block the number. If you already paid, call your bank and 997.
